title: Ordered tensor of negative one-generator algebraic Koszul complexes
statement: For a commutative ring A, r natural and a : Fin r → A, let K_m(a) be the reindexed exterior Koszul complex of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion], with powers a_i^(m+1). Define B_m(empty)=A[0], and B_m(a_0,tail)=Tot(K_m(a_0) tensor_A B_m(tail)), using the usual total differential. Its transition is identity in the empty case and tensor of the one-generator exterior transition with the tail transition in the successor case. Define the degree-zero map A→B_m by the empty-complex unit in rank zero, and the tensor of the first and tail exterior units included in summand (0,0) in the successor case. The exterior degree-zero unit A→K_m(a)^0 is the inverse zeroth exterior equivalence followed by the reindexing identification. All objects and maps are explicitly constructed, with no chosen existence witnesses.
